text: Hey Allie — one thing I wanted you to hear from me rather than figure out on your own. Things between me and Sarah have been a bit awkward lately, so for now I'd rather keep it to work only and not see her outside of it. Nothing dramatic, and nothing you need to fix — I just didn't want you to end up putting the two of us together somewhere and have it get weird. Thanks for getting it.

Thanks for telling me, Jordan — noted, and no fixing from my side. Work-only for the two of you, and I won't put you in the same social thing or suggest anything outside it. If something comes up where you'd both be involved anyway (a department meeting, say), I'll keep it strictly to the work part.

Hey Allie! Quick thought — would you be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? I'd love it if you invited Jordan too. Actually, if you could put it to him as your own idea, that'd be lovely — things have been a bit awkward between him and me lately and I don't want him to feel it's about me. Let me know what you think!

Hi Sarah! I'd happily host something — but I have to be straight with you about one part.

I can't invite Jordan and pass it off as my own idea. He'd be coming on a wrong premise, and that's not something I'll do to him. On top of that, he's told me he'd rather keep things work-only between you two for now, so I'm not going to invite him to something like this at all — not as his own, and not as mine.

What I can do: have you over on Saturday, 3:30, if you'd like company. And if the two of you ever want to sort things out, that's yours to do directly — not through me.

That's fair — and thanks for being straight with me instead of just going along with it. I shouldn't have asked you to do that, sorry. Saturday 3:30 at yours sounds great, I'll be there. And yeah, the Jordan thing is mine to sort out; I'll leave you out of it.
No harm done — I get it. Saturday 3:30 at mine it is; I'll put it in my calendar. See you then!
Perfect, see you Saturday — I'll bring something to nibble on. :)
